rules: Use a native anchor for navigation.
Default type is button; opt into submit.
Supply an accessible name for icon-only content.

components.summary: Labeled text entry with associated help and error messages
components.example: <TextField label="Project name" description="Shown to your team." />
rules: Use label for a visible accessible name.
className styles the outer field; internal DOM selectors are private.
Not a number, money, date, file or checkbox input.
Preserves external aria-describedby IDs.

components.summary: Compound modal with Radix focus and dismissal behavior
rules: Provide title, description or an explicit accessible description strategy.
Provide a visible close action.
Wrap in Theme so portaled content retains scoped color mode.
Use asChild with one ref-capable child.

components.summary: Explicit scoped color mode, including dialog portals
rules: Import token and component CSS once.
Theme is explicit; application owns persisted preference and system detection.
Does not inject global reset or load fonts.

components.summary: Label, description and error composition for any form control
rules: Controls inside a Field spread useFieldControl().control (id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid).
Controls that are not labelable elements also set aria-labelledby={useFieldControl().labelId}.
Preserves external aria-describedby IDs before description and error.
className styles the outer field; internal DOM selectors are private.

components.summary: Labelled checkbox with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states
components.example: <Checkbox name="terms" label="I agree to the terms" />
rules: Always supply a visible label; clicking it toggles the checkbox.
Use indeterminate only for a parent that summarises mixed children.
Submits value (default on) only when checked.
Not a switch: use Checkbox for form choices that apply on submit.

components.summary: Labelled single-value select with a themed listbox
components.example: <Select name="currency" label="Currency" placeholder="Choose a currency"><SelectItem value="EUR">Euro (EUR)</SelectItem><SelectItem value="USD">US dollar (USD)</SelectItem></Select>
rules: For short, known lists; searchable or long lists need a combobox (planned, not implemented).
Item values are strings; do not use an empty string value.
Wrap in Theme so the portaled listbox keeps the scoped colour mode.
Not for actions: use DropdownMenu.

While open, Radix Select is always modal and aria-hides the rest of the page; full-page axe reports aria-hidden-focus for the hidden trigger. Focus stays in the listbox, so this is a known false positive.

components.summary: Tablist and panels with Radix keyboard navigation

props.TabsRoot: Radix Tabs.Root props (value, defaultValue, onValueChange, orientation, activationMode)

rules: Give TabsList an accessible name.
Every TabsTrigger value has a matching TabsContent.
Use activationMode="manual" when switching panels is expensive.
Not for navigation between routes: use links.

props.PopoverContent: Radix Popover.Content props (sideOffset default 8); supply aria-label or aria-labelledby

rules: Name the content with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Non-modal: use Dialog when the user must respond before continuing.
Wrap in Theme so portaled content keeps the scoped colour mode.
Use asChild with one ref-capable child.

components.summary: Action menu with keyboard navigation and typeahead

props.DropdownMenuRoot: Radix DropdownMenu.Root props; modal defaults to false (pass modal to block outside interaction and aria-hide the page)
props.DropdownMenuContent: Radix DropdownMenu.Content props (align default start, sideOffset default 4)

rules: For commands only; use links for navigation and Select for form values.
Mark destructive commands with tone="danger" and confirm irreversible ones.
Non-modal by default: the page stays in the accessibility tree, focus stays in the menu and Escape closes it; an outside click closes the menu and reaches its target.
Wrap in Theme so portaled content keeps the scoped colour mode.
Checkbox, radio and submenu items are not implemented.
